title: Choose reliable delivery over fire-and-forget PubSub
intent: Checks the answer replaces PubSub with Streams consumer groups for reliable delivery, explains PubSub non-persistence, and bounds stream growth.
prompt: Review this order-event delivery design and make delivery reliable.

input_artifacts.name: events.txt
input_artifacts.content: transport: PUBLISH order.events; consumers: subscribers that may be offline during deploys; assumption: 'PubSub is reliable, every consumer gets every message'; no acknowledgement; no retention bound

embedded_defects.defect: Uses PubSub for delivery that must be reliable and replayable.
Assumes PubSub persists and redelivers to offline subscribers.
No stream/retention bound if switched to Streams.
